issues.issue: Does the claimant's account establish that he is a Roma man and a gay man?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant is Roma and gay; his testimony and corroborative documents support both.
issues.result_quote: I accept, on the balance of probabilities, that the claimant is a gay man and a member of the Roma ethnicity.

issues.issue: Does the claimant face a well-founded fear of persecution in Hungary as a Roma and gay man?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant fears persecution in Hungary due to ethnicity and sexual orientation, citing discrimination and violence.
issues.result_quote: In considering the discrimination the claimant is likely to face as a Roma as well as a homosexual man, I find that when considered cumulatively, this treatment amounts to persecution
